reason: A DSH plugin for importing, validating, and restoring exported conversation archives or JSONL logs as new sessions, with configurable state synchronization and rollback handling.

summaries.zh: 用于将 DSH 导出的 ZIP 或 JSONL 会话文件校验后导入为新会话，并提供状态同步、预览和失败回滚功能。
summaries.en: Imports and validates DSH-exported ZIP or JSONL conversation files as new sessions with preview, configurable state synchronization, and rollback handling.

capabilities: Reads local ZIP archives and JSONL session logs
Validates archive structure, event sequences, and SHA-256 fingerprints
Creates new sessions in DSH persistence and attaches them to workspaces
Synchronizes selected session settings and supports rollback of failed imports
Provides local HTTP endpoints and an in-app import interface
